notes: **Item MRG3 — the Fig. 3 caption for the four genes** (user decision 2026-10-17). The former Fig. 3 and Fig. 4 captions are merged into one, checked against the approved figure: violins **a**–**e** (the GDSL gene's fiber and starch are **d** and **e**), barcodes **f**–**i**, the red triangles under **i**. As in the two former captions, the statistic above the panels is the Benjamini–Hochberg *q* for **a**–**c** and the *P* for **d**, **e**. The bracket sentence is unchanged: for the GDSL gene it compares its two groups, which is the same test (each group against the largest; with one comparison, Holm changes nothing). "Carried forward" is dropped from the title, because the GDSL gene was not one of the three genes carried forward; the figure shows the four candidate genes, as the Discussion and Conclusions name them.
